description: This file contains the implementation of the Language controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing language selection and persistence in the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class managing language selection, retrieval, and saving functionalities within the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the language selection interface; loads available languages, sets current language based on cookie or config, and passes data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the selected language, updates cookie, and redirects to the appropriate dashboard or URL.
